sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Anjul Dwivedi,Sai Girdhar,Vandana Mishra Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
1-Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P. and perused the record.
2-This Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been moved by the applicant after rejecting his anticipatory bail application by the order dated 21.02.2024 passed by learned Sessions Judge, Bareilly seeking Anticipatory Bail in Case Crime No. 03 of 2021, under Sections 409, 201, 204, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. and Sections 13(1)(A), 13(2) Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station Bareilly Sector (Vigilance Section), District Bareilly.
3-Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
Allegations levelled against the applicant are false and based on concocted facts.

The investigating officer has not conducted fair investigation and submitted charge-sheet no. 01 of 2023 Ompal Singh vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46006015/
1 dated 06.11.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is also submitted that in the departmental enquiry report dated 28.01.2016,
charges levelled against the applicant was not found proved.
On the complaint of the complainant-Misar Yaar Khan given before Lokayukta, no action has been taken and the said matter has come to end.

Lastly, it is submitted that he has apprehension of imminent arrest and in case,
applicant is released on anticipatory bail, he would not misuse the liberty and would cooperate with the trial.

4-Per contra learned Additional Govt. Advocate for the state of U.P. opposed the prayer for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant by contending that investigating officer after due investigation submitted charge sheet no. 01 of 2023 dated 06.11.2023 on the basis of cogent material against the applicant, on which the concerned court below took cognizance on 07.12.2023, therefore, as on date cognizable offence is made out against the applicant and it can not be presumed that he has been falsely implicated.

5-Object of section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, is that a person should not be unnecessarily harassed or humiliated in order to satisfy personal vendetta or grudge of complainant or any other person operating the things directly or from behind the curtains.

It is well settled that discretionary power conferred by the legislature on this court can-not be put in a straitjacket formula, but such discretionary power either grant or refusal of anticipatory bail has to be exercised carefully in appropriate cases with circumspection on the basis of the available material after evaluating the facts of the particular case and considering other relevant factors (nature and gravity of accusation, role attributed to accused, conduct of accused, criminal antecedents, possibility of the applicant to flee from Justice , apprehension of tampering of the witnesses or threat to the complainant, impact of grant of anticipatory bail in investigation or society, etc.) with meticulous precision maintaining balance between the conflicting interest, namely, sanctity of individual liberty and interest of society.

6- From the record, I find that during investigation, applicant had preferred a Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application U/s 438 Cr.P.C. No. 13207 of 2021 but no relief has been given to the applicant and the said anticipatory bail application was disposed of vide order dated 03.08.2021 observing that the applicant is free to agitate his claim at the stage of regular bail before the appropriate court.
The court below was also directed to consider the bail application of the applicant and to pass speaking and reasoned order accordingly, preferably on the same day.

7-In the light of above, looking to the facts and circumstances of this case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, as well as considering the fact that after investigation charge has been submitted against the applicant, this court is of the view that no case for exercising its discretionary power under section 438 Code of Criminal Procedure is made out in favour of applicant.
8-Accordingly this application under section 438 Cr.P.C. is rejected.

9-It is clarified that anything said in this order at this stage is limited to the purpose of determination of this anticipatory bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.

Learned Magistrate and trial court concerned shall be absolutely free to Ompal Singh vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46006015/
2 arrive at its independent conclusions according to law on the basis of materials / evidences on record.
